title: anime-creator asset catalog line (catalog/assets.jsonl), schema_version 1
description: One JSON object per line. `add` lines describe a file; `pin`/`unpin` lines change gc protection; `retire`/`revive` lines take an edl-work file out of and back into use; `quarantine`/`unquarantine`/`purge` lines record what gc did to a file. Lines are append-only; readers fold them in order (studio/asset_registry_catalog.py state()).

path.description: relative to the series dir, forward slashes; the file is never moved

seen.description: local time the scan wrote this record, with its UTC offset (older records have none)

parents.description: asset_ids this one was generated from (refs, first/last frame, input)

supersedes.description: the asset_id that held this path before: its bytes changed, or a re-scan learned its scene, shot or parents from the job (same bytes)

pinned.description: carried over from the superseded record on a same-bytes refresh; pin/unpin lines keep the who and why

duplicate_of.description: another current asset with the same bytes

op.description: retire: an edl-work file no EDL shows any more reads as status rejected until revive

oneOf.description: gc moved the file to catalog/quarantine/<batch>/<path> (quarantine), back (unquarantine) or deleted it from the batch (purge)
